CustomField.description: The correct answer value(s) for this question. Single id for MCQ_SINGLE/TRUE_FALSE/CODE_OUTPUT/SCENARIO; JSON array of ids for MCQ_MULTI.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For single-answer types store the option id (e.g. A). For MCQ_MULTI store a JSON array (e.g. ["A","C"]).
CustomField.label: Correct Answer
